_comment: Predicate registry. 'single_valued' predicates auto-retire a prior object during kb_extract consolidation, but only when the subject matches 'single_valued_subjects' — cardinality is a property of (subject, predicate), not of the predicate. A ticket has one status; a repo accumulates them. Everything else keeps both objects. 'aliases' fold synonyms onto one canonical predicate so kb_fact_query, which matches on the predicate, does not under-return across synonym silos. Extend or override per install with <KB_DIR>/predicates.json using the same shape — 'many_valued' there removes a built-in, 'aliases' merge with these, and 'single_valued_subjects' replaces this pattern.
